# The Rust lint port keeps backend selection separate from the Thunderbird wrapper

The entries retain payload=commlint:lint_wrapper, set wraps=mozcheck:lint and select the operation through check. The wrapper rewrites payload but forwards the remaining configuration. Both permission variants select file-perm, preserving the shebang setting; license retains its data-file dependency. This is local routing. The external Rust backend, runtime coverage and equivalence with earlier linters remain unverified.

Scope: commlint backend configuration.
